scope: one exploratory original-profile bare known-RIP breakpoint smoke; no fresh-process or performance gate qualification

timing_definitions.normal_stop_overhead_ns: return from overflow through correction, debug-off/RF cleanup, post-counter and scalar getters/validation; excludes overflow signal/KVM-return latency and witnesses
timing_definitions.overflow_elapsed_ns: guest execution to overflow plus signal/KVM-return administration, inseparable in this bracket
timing_definitions.landing_witness_ns: register JSON serialization plus RAM hash; final register SHA computed outside bracket
timing_definitions.continuation_total_ns: remaining guest execution plus terminal PIO and terminal full-state witness
timing_definitions.setup_ns: VM/counter setup, separate from initial witness

performance_gate: open; this one correction bracket alone exceeds budget by 631x; median not measured
